verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents HTTP APIs (Raw Event Export, Engage, Query, Feature Flags), JQL and a hosted MCP server. None of it mentions official client SDKs or language libraries for building against Mixpanel. APIs and MCP are adjacent interfaces, not the SDKs this story asks for, so absence of SDK evidence for an applicable axis yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
